subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Team Building Retreat
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce our upcoming annual team building retreat! This year, we will be heading to a beautiful resort in the mountains for a weekend of team bonding activities, workshops, and relaxation. Please mark your calendars for the weekend of October 15th-17th. More details regarding the itinerary and accommodation will be shared soon. We look forward to creating unforgettable memories together! Warm regards, The Organizing Committee
